idle: Clock's seven minutes fast. Always has been. Don't touch it.
good_ice: Ice looks lovely, hon. People stay longer. Buy more fries.
bad_ice: Everybody's coming off cold and cross, hon. I'm pouring extra gravy.
goal: Woo! Fries for everybody! No. Not for everybody.
cold: Hot chocolate's on, hon. Well. HOT CHOC LATE.
hungry: You look hungry, hon. You always look hungry.
long_line: Line's moving, hon! Keep it moving! Know your order!
A long line that moves is a beautiful thing.
greet_owner: There's my owner. What'll it be?
leaving_happy: Good night, hon. Chili's on Thursday.
leaving_angry: Fryer quit, coffee quit, I'm about to. Night, hon.

broomball: Grown people falling down in sneakers. Better than television.
tournament: My Olympics, hon. Four hundred fries by noon.
public_skate: Hot chocolate for forty-one. There'll be sixty. HOT CHOC LATE.
senior_hockey: No fries during the anthem. I mean it.

first.say: Hi, hon. You're the new owner. Lorraine, Hot Stove, twenty-two years. What'll it be?

first_coffee.say: Watch this. (She hits the machine where the dent is.) There. First one's on me, hon.

first_water.say: Just a water. Hon. It's a snack bar. Have a fry, at least. On me.

first_rec.say: Fries and Earl's gravy. I make it. He takes the credit. Don't tell him I told you.

say: Line was out the door and the fryer quit, hon. People were nice about it. For a while.

options.text: I'll get the fryer looked at.

tourney.say: Tournament weekend, hon. My Olympics. Four hundred fries by noon. Keep the line moving or I'll put you on the counter.

public.say: Public skate. I've got hot chocolate for exactly forty-one kids. There'll be sixty. HOT CHOC LATE, like the sign says.

say: There's my favourite. Fries are on the house. Don't tell Terry.
Hi, hon. Talk while I work, I never stop.
Hon. You look hungry. You always look hungry.

options.text: What's your favourite thing to watch?
What's the word on the rink?

job.say: Four fryers, one coffee machine, twenty-two years. The machine works if you hit it where the dent is. If the dent moves, we're in trouble.

events.say: Broomball. Grown people falling down in sneakers. And the Kings, for the crowd, and the crowd for the fries.

josie.say: Smartest kid on that counter in twenty years. Saving up for something. Won't say what. I know what.

gravy.say: Flour, drippings, a secret, and Earl standing nearby looking proud. That last part's important.

options.text: Are people happier in the line?

rink_good.say: New counter, hon, and nobody's cold in the line. I sold more hot chocolate this week than all last winter.

coffee.say: (Thunk.) There you go, hon. On the house. You own the house.
